visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Indoor living room scene. A woman in a blue checkered dress and a young boy in a white t-shirt prepare for a performance. Two tall towers of colorful plastic blocks stand in the foreground. The woman kneels while the boy holds a small blue toy guitar. The lighting is warm and bright. (2) The boy starts strumming the toy guitar as background music plays. The woman stands still, watching him with a smile. The camera captures them in a full shot. There is an inset graphic showing a hand pressing a button. (3) The boy puts down the guitar and picks up a small blue cup, using it as a pretend microphone. He moves with energy, mimicking a singer. The woman remains in her position, her eyes fixed on him. Captions appear on the screen. (4) Transitioning back to the guitar, the boy continues his energetic performance. He ducks down and pops back up. The woman adjusts her posture but continues to watch him intently. The block towers remain steady in front of them. (5) The boy and woman look at each other with focused expressions. A ginger and white cat wanders into the frame at the bottom right. The boy is still "singing" into the cup, holding it close to his mouth. (6) The performance concludes. The boy and woman exchange a high-five, and in the process, they joyfully knock down one of the tall towers of blocks. They both exhibit happy facial expressions as the video ends.
